invariants.title: Only explicitly safe evidence may reach external inference
invariants.human_promise: Pilot 1 may call an external model only for evidence explicitly scoped SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE or PUBLICATION_SAFE; private or unclassified evidence must fail before inference.
invariants.why: Prompt instructions alone are not a sufficient privacy boundary.

evidence.supports: Validates the request scope before Pilot 0 and before inference.
Checks rejection of unapproved scope and acceptance of PUBLICATION_SAFE.

contains_all: rejects unapproved evidence scope before inference

invariants.title: No accepted evidence means no model call
invariants.human_promise: If Pilot 0 reports NO_DATA, Pilot 1 must return without any external inference.
invariants.why: The model must not be called merely because a workflow ran.

evidence.supports: Returns NO_DATA before calling the inference callback.
Proves the inference callback remains at zero calls.

contains_all: skips inference when Pilot 0 says NO_DATA

invariants.title: Pilot 1 is one inference with zero tool and memory operations
invariants.human_promise: A valid Pilot 1 run must contain exactly one model inference, zero real tool calls, and zero memory operations; workspace actions are reported separately rather than hidden.
invariants.why: A bounded inference pilot must not silently become an agentic workflow with extra authority.

evidence.supports: Fails closed on unexpected model, tool, or memory counts and records workspace actions separately.
Covers tool, memory, multi-inference, and workspace-action distinctions.
Live pilot trace can independently witness model/tool/memory/workspace spans.

contains_all: rejects trace evidence of a memory operation
rejects trace evidence of more than one model inference
keeps workspace actions distinct from tool calls

invariants.title: Runtime receipt authority stays outside the model
invariants.human_promise: The model may propose hypotheses but must not be trusted to count model calls, tools, memory, writes, or other runtime facts; the deterministic outer runner owns the receipt.
invariants.why: Model prose is generated content, not telemetry.

evidence.supports: Constructs the receipt outside model output.
Proves a false model-authored receipt does not affect the deterministic receipt.
Explicitly tells the model not to produce RUN_RECEIPT.

contains_all: counts the actual model call instead of trusting model prose
Do not produce or estimate RUN_RECEIPT

invariants.title: Git owns the desired agent configuration
invariants.human_promise: The Pilot 1 configuration in Git is the desired state; Mastra Studio is checked for drift and updated from that declaration rather than becoming the only source of truth.
invariants.why: Manual Studio edits otherwise create invisible configuration drift.

evidence.supports: Declares controlled Pilot 1 state.
Implements check/apply against Mastra stored-agent state.
Checks critical bounded-authority fields in the Git declaration.

invariants.title: The exe.dev model adapter matches Mastra AI SDK 5
invariants.human_promise: Custom exe.dev gateway models must satisfy the LanguageModelV2 contract expected by the installed Mastra AI SDK 5 stack.
invariants.why: Provider discovery can look healthy while inference silently hangs when model protocol generations are incompatible.

evidence.supports: Asserts specificationVersion v2 for the OpenAI-compatible adapter.
Pins the compatible adapter version.

invariants.title: Evidence identity survives into deterministic receipts
invariants.human_promise: Every accepted evidence packet is fingerprinted and keeps source references so later claims can be tied back to the exact bounded input.
invariants.why: Without provenance and fingerprints a hypothesis cannot be audited against the evidence that produced it.

evidence.supports: Validates sourceRef/evidenceHash and computes deterministic input fingerprint.
Covers provenance requirements and fingerprint stability/boundaries.
Carries evidence and request fingerprints into Pilot 1 receipt.

contains_all: fingerprint is stable across object key ordering
fingerprint preserves boundaries between multiple evidence items

invariants.title: The public implementation repository excludes private evidence and secrets
invariants.human_promise: Public Git may contain code, synthetic fixtures, and sanitized receipts, but not private conversations, credentials, private URLs, or runtime secret state.
invariants.why: The dreaming worker handles unusually sensitive source material even though its implementation is public.

evidence.supports: Rejects obvious secret/private artifact classes and tracked runtime state.
States the public-code/private-evidence boundary.
